title: Note Summarizer — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Condenses lengthy lecture notes into key points and action items. The Note Summarizer condenses lengthy lecture notes into key points. It extracts the main ideas, definitions, dates, and action items, drops repetition and filler, and returns a short structured summary that preserves the original meaning. Long notes become a one-page brief the student can actually review.
capabilities: Extract main ideas, definitions, and dates from notes
Remove repetition and filler while preserving meaning
Produce a structured one-page brief
List action items and deadlines found in the notes
Keep summaries faithful to the original notes
